newsitem.title: FRANCE: EP approves open network provision directive.
newsitem.headline: EP approves open network provision directive.

text.p: New EU rules to regulate the European Union telecommunications market after liberalisation on January 1 next year are set to come into force following their approval on Wednesday by the European Parliament.

Euro-MPs gave the green light to draft directive COM(95)379 after conciliation talks with the Council of Ministers led to a deal which ensured parliament's demands for guarantees of a universal service, the creation of a European Regulatory Authority to settle disputes, and a pledge that customers would not be charged for taking their phone and fax numbers with them if they moved, or changed phone company.

The aim of the so-called open network provision (ONP) directive is to harmonise the conditions under which telecoms companies must operate in the newly liberalised environment, including issues relating to market access and fair competition.
